descriptionFull: The common black hawk ( Buteogallus anthracinus ) is a bird of prey in the family Accipitridae, which also includes the eagles, hawks, and Old World vultures. It formerly included the Cuban black-hawk ( Buteogallus gundlachii ) as a subspecies. The mangrove black hawk, traditionally considered a distinct species, is now generally considered a subspecies, B. a. subtilis , of the common black-hawk.
